notes.title: 20240715 Patch Notes
notes.content: Added subtitles to the OP song, available when the game is not in Chinese.

notes.title: 20231013 Patch Notes
notes.content: Optimized the English localization of the game.

notes.title: Functional Patch
notes.content:
1. Russian is now supported
2. Optimized UI and control. You can now use arrow keys, space key and enter key to read the script. 
3. Optimized the display of texts. 
4. Optimized how DLC function in the game.

notes.title: Patch Note (Long Overdue, sorry!)
notes.content:
Fixed grammar mistakes and typos of the script. The biggest shout-out to my man @woosk for helping us do it. 


https://steamcommunity.com/groups/vnislife
This is the anime fan group woosk and his friends are in, you are more than welcome to join! If you like any of the games we have published so far, you are also welcome to send any of the group's admins a friend invite and to follow the group's curator list.

notes.title: Hotfix regarding Fox Hime Cosplay Album DLC
notes.content: You should have no trouble finding the content here FoxHime_Data/StreamingAssets/UserOutput/OriginalDLCPic（WindowsOS）or FoxHime.app/Contents/StreamingAssets/UserOutput/OriginalDLCPic（MacOS）.

notes.title: FoxHime Patch
notes.content:
Add a button for export DLC photos, click it and the current DLC photo will be saved to path "Game installation directory/FoxHime_Data/StreamingAssets/UserOuput" (Windows) or "FoxHime.app/Contents/StreamingAssets/UserOuput" (MacOS)

Our new game FoxHime Zero is coming soon. > <
